answer: Nonce-bound answer channel. Each request carries a fresh challenge the agent must sign with a secret whose seed includes the prior response, so replaying a captured answer fails verification and the empty shell previously registered as an identity goes hollow at once. An attacker must solve and submit a unique fresh answer per identity, converting every fake account into real compute and latency spend rather than a one-time cost. Because the challenge binds the response to a velvet-signed timestamp window, copied proofs leave a visible pigment of reuse in the chain log.
